# GSAP 3.15.0

Local browser builds of GSAP and ScrollTrigger from the published `gsap` npm package. Used by the motion playground and landing page. Local files keep the preview independent of a CDN.

Original copyright and licence notices are retained in both JavaScript files. The package specifies: Standard 'no charge' license, https://gsap.com/standard-license.

Project: https://gsap.com/
